title: Avatars are stretched out of shape when the picture is not square: the shared AvatarImage has no object-fit, so most call sites draw it with the browser default fill
body: Filed from a maintainer-driven session at the maintainer's request (「头像显示是不是有问题啊，被压缩的变形了」 → 「创建issue」). Read from the code on main `e7399fcd`, not measured live. Not claimed. Suggested-grade: p2 Suggested-domain: `domain:ui` ## What happens A non-square user photo or org logo is squashed or stretched to fit the round avatar. A square picture looks fine, so the defect only shows for some users. ## Why `ui/packages/components/src/ui/avatar.tsx` (`AvatarImage`) sets `aspect-square h-full w-full` on the `` and no `object-fit`. The browser default is `fill`, which scales each axis on its own. A few call sites patch it locally with `className="object-cover"` (`plugin-detail/src/CommentAuthorAvatar.tsx`, `app-shell/.../manage/SettingsPage.tsx`) or choose cover/contain (`components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, the record-header picture). Every other `AvatarImage` draws stretched, including: - `app-shell/src/layout/AccountMenu.tsx` (header account button and its menu) - `app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/MembersPage.tsx`, `OrganizationsPage.tsx` - `fields/src/index.tsx` (user field cells), `fields/src/widgets/AvatarField.tsx`, `LookupField.tsx` (single value and chips), `PersonRow.tsx`, `SelectionTray.tsx` - `plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` (card owner), `plugin-detail/src/HistoryTimeline.tsx`, `plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx` - `components/src/renderers/data-display/avatar.tsx` (the schema `avatar` renderer) ## How other products handle it Avatar components in common UI libraries (shadcn/ui, Ant Design, MUI, Chakra) draw the image with `object-fit: cover` by default: scale to fill the circle, keep the aspect ratio, crop the overflow. Products such as GitHub and Slack also crop to a square at upload time. Logos are the usual exception and use `contain`. The record-header picture here already makes that split. ## Ask 1. Make `object-cover` the default on the shared `AvatarImage`, so every call site is fixed in one place. A caller that wants a logo-style fit still passes `object-contain`, which overrides it. 2. Drop the local `object-cover` patches that become redundant. 3. Pin it with a test: `AvatarImage` renders with `object-cover` when no class is given, and a passed `object-contain` wins. ## Out of scope - A square-crop step in `AvatarField`'s upload. Worth its own card if wanted. ## Re-check Set a non-square picture (e.g. 400×200) as a user's image and open the account menu, the members page, and a record with a user field: the face keeps its proportions and is cropped to the circle when this is fixed.
